description.en: Each workspace in your sidebar with how many agents are working in it and which chats wait for you; click one to go there. A tab of its own shows a live feed of what your workspaces, agents and chats are doing.

tagline.en: See which workspaces have agents at work and chats waiting for you

scopes.workspace:read: See your workspaces and notice when one changes.
scopes.workspace:write: Switch to a workspace when you click its row.
scopes.agent:read: Count the agents working in each workspace.
scopes.agent_chat:read: See which chats wait for your answer.
